## FNATIC — Pre-Match Scouting Summary

**Roster Composition**

Six players: one duelist, two initiators, two controllers, one sentinel. Alfajer is the designated flex.

---

**Firepower**

kaajak leads the team at 234 ACS / 1.07 rating and is a near-pure Neon specialist (92% of play). He is the clear primary carry.

Alfajer is the second firepower option at 215 ACS / 1.05 rating — notable given his sentinel/flex role. His agent pool is the widest on the roster: Cypher (42%), Viper (21%), Waylay (13%), Raze (8%), Killjoy (8%), Vyse (4%), Chamber (4%). No single agent dominates his time, which makes his role assignment genuinely variable game to game.

The rest of the roster clusters tightly between 171–189 ACS. Veqaj (189 ACS, 0.93 rating) is the higher-fragging controller of the two, though still below the team's top two. crashies (173 ACS) posts a 1.03 rating despite sitting fifth in ACS — the only player outside the top two with a rating above 1.00 outside of kaajak and Alfajer.

---

**Agent Pools**

- **Veqaj** is heavily committed to Viper (75%), with Kayo as his only alternative (25%).
- **Cloud** splits across Sova (56%), Skye (17%), Tejo (17%), and Fade (11%) — the more varied of the two initiators.
- **crashies** runs Sova (46%), Fade (33%), Skye (21%) — a tighter initiator pool than Cloud's.
- **Boaster** spreads across Omen (38%), Astra (21%), Harbor (21%), and Brimstone (21%) — no dominant pick, suggesting he adapts his controller selection rather than anchoring to one.

---

**No limited-data flags** were raised for any of the six players in this window.
